== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm) (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/linv8m_japanese_white_border/50650 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/eeac67fc962b47169a8143acb320ce1c/IMG_20220607_0124.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(18, 10, 764, 1054)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>ef46c786d9ac54a35e7a8b627d71929c074665000ef942de904d962c4af146bc</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
